title: Goat OS stg — Mobile (goatos-android)
description: App-start, screen render, network latency, crash-free rate, and funnel conversion for the goatos-android app per OBSERVABILITY_DESIGN.md section 2.5. Firebase Performance/Crashlytics/Analytics live in Firebase console; this dashboard covers the OTel-Android OkHttp network spans/latency that land beside backend spans, plus a funnel view rolled up from GA4 into Postgres per section 2.6.

panels.title: Login -> submit journey duration p50 / p90 / p99 (app-start/screen render live in Firebase Perf)
panels.description: Sourced from Firebase Performance app-start traces exported to BigQuery, then rolled into analytics.journey_daily by the analytics-rollup Cloud Run Job (infra/envs/stg/analytics_rollup.tf) — not a native OTel metric.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_date AS time, p50_ms/1000.0 AS p50_seconds, p90_ms/1000.0 AS p90_seconds, p99_ms/1000.0 AS p99_seconds FROM analytics.journey_daily WHERE tenant_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' AND journey_key = 'login_to_submit' AND $__timeFilter(event_date) ORDER BY event_date

panels.title: Network round-trip p50 / p90 / p99 (OTel-Android OkHttp interceptor)

options.text: Screen render performance tracking requires a per-screen breakdown table in analytics.* (analytics.screen_render_daily or similar) rolled up from Firebase Performance app-start traces. As of migration 000168, only journey_daily (app-level) is available. A screen-keyed rollup table or dedicated journey_daily per-screen extension is a backend follow-up. TODO: sync with analytics-rollup job owners.

panels.title: Crash-free session rate (rollup from Crashlytics BQ export, 24h)

targets.rawSql: SELECT crash_free_sessions_pct FROM analytics.crash_daily WHERE tenant_id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' AND event_date = (SELECT max(event_date) FROM analytics.crash_daily WHERE tenant_id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001') ORDER BY app_version DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Funnel conversion: login -> bootstrap -> drive-open -> scan -> vaccination-capture -> submit
panels.description: Rolled up from Firebase Analytics (GA4) daily BigQuery export by the analytics-rollup Cloud Run Job into analytics.funnel_daily, keyed on the AnalyticsEvents funnel steps in OBSERVABILITY_DESIGN.md section 2.5.

targets.rawSql: SELECT step_key AS funnel_step, step_index AS step_order, users, ROUND(100.0 * conversions / NULLIF(users,0), 1) AS conversion_pct FROM analytics.funnel_daily WHERE tenant_id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' AND funnel_key = 'goatos_mobile_core' AND event_date = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' ORDER BY step_index
